column1: # The raids, one row each, in the Combat Summary's order: everything the plugin knows about a raid, so the next one is a
# row here (Dylan, 2026-11-08). A hard mode shares its raid's log, so it reads on the raid's own card: its cell opens
# that card, where its KC and PB are a second row under the short name the Combat Summary pairs it by.
# Columns: tile name<TAB>RuneLite's HiscoreSkill name<TAB>the hiscore row's name<TAB>the hard mode's HiscoreSkill name
# ("-": none)<TAB>its short name<TAB>whether the tile waits for the hiscores to carry the raid's row ("wait": a raid
# whose launch-day hiscores may not have it yet; "-": always shown)<TAB>the game's Collection Log page<TAB>the megarare
# that headlines its tile and the Mega Rares row (its log slot's item id)<TAB>that item's name.
